title: Routes Keep Moving
style: Noise-heavy industrial dubstep with thick brown-noise sub layers, abrasive broadband static, distorted female soprano lead, and sharply contrasting half-time drops. Open with a grainy noise bed and close, tense vocal; build with metallic percussion and rising bass distortion; hit with huge syncopated wobble bass drops, then pull back to sparse documentary-like verses. Keep the soprano piercing and emotionally controlled, with fragmented doubles and clipped tails. Dense, deliberately degraded texture, powerful low end, abrupt edits, clear vocal placement.
lyrics:
[Intro]
A route marked in pencil
A name under glass

[Verse 1]
Rotterdam, then London, then Punta on the page
A train cuts the distance, a car waits in the rain
One hand on the folder, one sleeve outside the frame
You keep the moving pieces; I keep the names

[Pre-Chorus]
Window, mirror, pinboard, file
Every view is filed awhile
You turn away; the records stay

[Chorus]
Who is watching who tonight?
Who gets written out of sight?
Back turned, face held in the glass
Routes keep moving; records last

[Drop]
Back turned
Face held
Routes keep moving
Records last

[Verse 2]
Diary, ledger, bio, drafts in a row
Translations folded where the causeway meets the road
Teal in the window, violet on the board
Orange-red at the doorway, two lives sharing one code

[Pre-Chorus]
Daylight settles on the names
Night rewrites the picture frames
You turn away; the records stay

[Chorus]
Who is watching who tonight?
Who gets written out of sight?
Back turned, face held in the glass
Routes keep moving; records last

[Bridge]
At the airport, she takes the seat across from me
A white blouse, a folder, a question I can’t keep
You were only ever shoulders at the edge
Now I see the empty chair, and what it says

[Final Drop]
Who is watching who?
Who is written out?
Back turned
Face held
Routes keep moving
Records last

[Outro]
A route marked in pencil
The page stays open
